game.name: R.u.s.e. (UK)
game.desc: R.U.S.E. is a real-time strategy game on 360 that takes us to the middle of World War II, through 23 missions of progressive difficulty. The title is based on a classic system of resource acquisition and unit construction, but introduces the concept of "tricks", powers that allow you to obtain information or, on the contrary, to deceive the enemy. The game also offers a complete multiplayer mode, supported by a system of leagues and experience points.
